newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh PM Hasina congratulates Tony Blair.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh PM Hasina congratulates Tony Blair.

text.p: Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Friday congratulated her new British counterpart Tony Blair, saying his party's landslide election victory was a glowing tribute to his leadership.
"This success is indeed a glowing tribute to your able leadership and reflects the confidence of the people of Britain in you to lead them into the next century," Hasina said in a message to Blair.

"I have no doubt that the historic and traditional ties (between Bangladesh and Britain) will be even further strengthened during your tenure. I look forward to working with you in close cooperation in promoting international peace, security and development."

Earlier, Bangladesh's State Minister for Foreign Affairs Abul Hasan Chowdhury said: "I confidently look towards a strengthening of the existing good relations and more meaningful cooperation (with Britain) in future.
Bangladesh, formerly East Pakistan, was part of British India until independence in 1947.
